Name: Bookstore Clone-to-Lake (raw, no unique IDs)
Description:
Demonstrates a 'clone' that pulls the RAW records from a customer data beacon into a Postgres lake WITHOUT the source needing unique identifiers.

Topology: ultravisor + auth-beacon, a customer retold-databeacon (MySQL-backed, pre-loaded with a deliberately awkward bookstore-sales schema), a lake retold-databeacon (Postgres-backed), retold-data-mapper (hosts the customer + lake connections and runs the clone tasks), and a one-shot seed-bookstore-clone container.

The customer DB (modelling a customer's existing database) has seven tables — Cashier, City, Bookstore, Book, Price, Author, Sale — with NO integer surrogate keys: some use plain string keys (City.CityName, Author.AuthorName, Bookstore.BookstoreCode, Cashier.CashierCode), some need a combinatorial key (Book = Title+AuthorName), and some have no unique identifier at all with intentional duplicates (Price, and Sale whose 'key' is the three strings BookstoreCode+Title+SaleDate — several rows collide on all three, a couple byte-for-byte).

The seeder enables read endpoints on the customer tables, creates RAW_<Table> archive tables on the lake, then runs one Ultravisor operation per table: pull → buildcomprehension (keyless rows keyed positionally record-N) → writerecordsraw. Each source row lands in the lake verbatim as { Identity, RawJSON, RecordMD5, IngestedAt, SourceTable } — duplicates preserved, RecordMD5 flags exact copies. No source unique identifier is ever required.

Walkthrough after `Up` (the seeder runs automatically):
  1. Browse the customer beacon at http://127.0.0.1:${input.CustomerBeaconPort} — the 7 keyless tables, incl. duplicate Sale rows.
  2. Browse the lake beacon at http://127.0.0.1:${input.LakeBeaconPort} — the RAW_* archive tables; every customer row is preserved with its RawJSON + RecordMD5 + SourceTable.
  3. Inspect the clone operations in the data-mapper / Ultravisor at http://127.0.0.1:${input.MapperPort} and http://127.0.0.1:${input.UVPort}.

DataRoot.Description: Base directory for all volume mounts (mysql + postgres + ultravisor + each beacon + mapper data). Subdirectories created on first launch.

MonorepoRoot.Description: Path to your retold monorepo checkout. All retold-* images are built from MonorepoRoot/modules/... at launch, and the customer seed SQL + seeder script are mounted from MonorepoRoot/modules/apps/ultravisor-lab/source/stacks/seeders/bookstore-clone/.

UVAdminPassword.Description: Bootstrap admin password for Ultravisor; also the bearer password every beacon (customer, lake, data-mapper) presents at registration.

DBPassword.Description: Root password for both the customer MySQL and the lake Postgres. Same secret for both is fine in the lab.

UVPort.Description: Host port for the Ultravisor API + web UI.

MapperPort.Description: Host port for retold-data-mapper's REST + web UI.

CustomerBeaconPort.Description: Host port for the customer retold-databeacon (the source we clone from — browse its 7 keyless tables here).

LakeBeaconPort.Description: Host port for the lake retold-databeacon (the clone target — browse the RAW_* archive tables here).

CustomerMysqlPort.Description: Host port for the customer MySQL listener (backs the customer beacon; seeded on first boot from customer-init.sql).

PostgresPort.Description: Host port for the lake Postgres listener (backs the lake beacon).
